crossRefs.note: You make him ruler over the works of your hands. You have put all things under his feet:
All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows the Son, except the Father; neither does anyone know…
Jesus came to them and spoke to them, saying, “All authority has been given to me in heaven and on earth.
The Father loves the Son, and has given all things into his hand.
Jesus, knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he came from God, and was going to God,
which he worked in Christ, when he raised him from the dead and made him to sit at his right hand in the heavenly…
Therefore God also highly exalted him, and gave to him the name which is above every name,
But which of the angels has he told at any time, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies the footstool of your…
You have put all things in subjection under his feet.” For in that he subjected all things to him, he left nothing that…
but he, when he had offered one sacrifice for sins forever, sat down on the right hand of God,
who is at the right hand of God, having gone into heaven, angels and authorities and powers being made subject to him.
and the Living one. I was dead, and behold, I am alive forever and ever. Amen. I have the keys of Death and of Hades.

translations.web: For, “He put all things in subjection under his feet.” But when he says, “All things are put in subjection”, it is evident that he is excepted who subjected all things to him.
translations.bsb: For “God has put everything under His feet.” Now when it says that everything has been put under Him, this clearly does not include the One who put everything under Him.
translations.kjv: For he hath put all things under his feet. But when he saith all things are put under him, it is manifest that he is excepted, which did put ➔ all things under him.
translations.asv: For, He put all things in subjection under his feet. But when he saith, All things are put in subjection, it is evident that he is excepted who did subject all things unto him.
